name: To Show Due Judgment
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
With my blessings, take the censer.  I myself have used it in several exorcisms, and it should serve you well for the arduous tasks that lie ahead.

Return now to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind, adventurer.  Your quest continues with him.
narrative.objectives: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Yes, this will do. You will be called upon more than once during this process to make acts of sacrifice; I am glad to see that you are willing to do just that. Sacrifice is a key component in what it takes to uphold the duties of being a Paladin... but I don't have to lecture you on that.

Now adventurer, you will need to show due judgment in your actions. To that end, this censer will act as your vessel to dispense such judgment on tortured spirits of lands lost to us.
narrative.requestItemsText: Welcome back, adventurer. Have you acquired the exorcism censer?

chain.subtitle: 13 quests at level 60, 44,600 XP in all.

quests.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

quests.name: Emphasis on Sacrifice
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Ironforge and get High Priest Rohan's Exorcism Censer.

quests.name: To Show Due Judgment
quests.objectiveText: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Exorcising Terrordale
quests.objectiveText: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale.

quests.name: The Work of Grimand Elmore
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Grimand Elmore in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

quests.name: Collection of Goods
quests.objectiveText: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Ancient Equine Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse.

quests.name: Grimand's Finest Work
quests.objectiveText: Take the Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District for his inspection.

quests.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
quests.objectiveText: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

quests.name: The Divination Scryer
quests.objectiveText: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Judgment and Redemption
quests.objectiveText: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance.
